description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום
description.summary: This table outlines the claim provisions for a pollution liability insurance policy. It details the required notifications to the insurer upon discovery of a pollution event or receipt of a claim.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את הוראות התביעה עבור פוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום. יש לדווח על 'אירוע זיהום' או 'תביעה' לחברת הביטוח בהקדם האפשרי, תוך מתן פרטים מזהים. המידע הנדרש כולל זמן, מקום, הסבר מפורט על האירוע, שמות וכתובות של נפגעים ועדים, וכל דו״ח או מידע רלוונטי אחר. פוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום דורשת העברה מיידית של כל דרישה, הודעה, זימון או מסמך משפטי אחר שהתקבל על ידי המבוטח או נציגיו. 'אירוע זיהום', 'עלויות ניקיון', 'נזק' ו'נזק אחר' הם מושגים מרכזיים בפוליסה זו. 'תביעה', 'מבוטח', ו'גילוי' הם מונחים חשובים להבנת תנאי הפוליסה.

sketch:
VII. CLAIM PROVISIONS
A. NOTICE OF DISCOVERY OR CLAIM
In the event of a "discovery" or 'claim", the 'insured' shall give written notice to us as  soon  as  possible  containing  particulars  sufficient  to  identify  an  'insured'  and reasonably obtainable information including:
The  time,  place,  location,  and  a  detailed  explanation  of  the  'pollution  event' including,  as  applicable,  the  date  of  "discovery"  or  the  date  the  "insured" received the 'claim";
The names and addresses of any injured parties and available witnesses;
Any and all investigative or engineering reports, data or information about the 'pollution event", "cleanup costs", "loss", or "other loss"; and
Any  and  all  other  relevant  information  about  the  "pollution  event",  'claim', 'cleanup costs', 'loss', or "other loss".
If a 'claim' is made against an 'insured", the 'insured' shall immediately forward to  us  every  demand, notice, summons, complaint, order or other process or legal papers received by an 'insured' or its representatives.

טבלה: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום
This table outlines the claim provisions for a pollution liability insurance policy. It details the required notifications to the insurer upon discovery of a pollution event or receipt of a claim.
ממדים: Claim Reporting Requirements, Information to be Provided

VII. CLAIM PROVISIONS
A. NOTICE OF DISCOVERY OR CLAIM
In the event of a "discovery" or 'claim", the 'insured' shall give written notice to us as  soon  as  possible  containing  particulars  sufficient  to  identify  an  'insured'  and reasonably obtainable information including:
The  time,  place,  location,  and  a  detailed  explanation  of  the  'pollution  event' including,  as  applicable,  the  date  of  "discovery"  or  the  date  the  "insured" received the 'claim";
The names and addresses of any injured parties and available witnesses;
Any and all investigative or engineering reports, data or information about the 'pollution event", "cleanup costs", "loss", or "other loss"; and
Any  and  all  other  relevant  information  about  the  "pollution  event",  'claim', 'cleanup costs', 'loss', or "other loss".
If a 'claim' is made against an 'insured", the 'insured' shall immediately forward to  us  every  demand, notice, summons, complaint, order or other process or legal papers received by an 'insured' or its representatives.
